Resolves #21447

🌿 *Buttons, Menus & Toolbars can no longer open on a test harness, a tree of placeholder buttons and a paging toolbar with nothing to page.*

The group goes from no card to three. `examples/menu/contextFiles` is new: project files in a list, where a right-click selects a file and opens its context menu at the pointer (Open, Duplicate, Move to › the two other folders, Star, Delete), a right-click on the free space offers New file, and every action changes the list and the status line. `examples/menu/context` stays the page `ContextMenuNL.spec.mjs` drives. `examples/toolbar/breadcrumb` now walks the engine repository's folders: the page shows a folder's description and subfolders, a subfolder goes down, a crumb goes back up, and the hash route keeps the place. `grid-server-side` joins the group through `alsoIn`, so `Neo.toolbar.Paging` shows on #21189's simulated server without a second copy of it. Two fixes came with the covers: the breadcrumb's chevrons used the filled-button text color and nearly vanished on neo-dark's toolbar, and a capture recipe could not right-click. The covers ship in neomjs/pages#126.

Evidence: L3 (unit and e2e specs in CI; scripted runs and frames of both pages) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-5). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- **`Neo.menu.List` (from Euclid's review):** items that replace a menu's items destroy its cached submenus (`destroySubMenus()`, shared with `destroy()`), so a reused key such as `move` rebuilds its submenu from the new item; before, the second file's Move to acted on the first.
- **`Breadcrumb.css`:** the separator takes `--button-tertiary-text-color`, the color of the tertiary crumbs; `--button-text-color` is the filled buttons' (black on neo-dark, white on the light themes).
- **`captureExamples.mjs`:** a `click` step takes `button: left | right`; no other action takes one. A context menu's cover needs the right-click.
- **The breadcrumb opens on `src`**, which has five subfolders, and gained `datahandling` and `uibuildingblocks` under `guides` so its cover shows three crumbs.
- **`seo.json`:** the generator's three entries for this change (the group, the new page, the breadcrumb page). The missing `WebDesktops` route stays with its defect-note.

Both read the released page as a test page. The empty lower half and the crumbs' size are open for review; the cover opens three levels down, at `guides`. The context-menu page and the group page are new and have no released counterpart; their frames are above.

## Addressed Review Feedback

Responding to the review above (Request Changes at 402f75bf08).

**Completion gate:** A = open Required Actions; B = #21447's ACs + PR-body claims + actual diff. A is empty relative to B at this head.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** Make Move to use the current file and its eligible folders after successive right-clicks. Add a regression opening Move to for files in two different folders, then verify the selected second file moves and the first file stays put.
      **Commit:** b4860ca006
      **Details:** Your trace was right, and the cause sat in the engine: `Neo.menu.List#afterSetItems()` refilled the store but kept `subMenuMap`, so the reused key `move` reopened the submenu built for the first file. Items that replace the items now hide and destroy the cached submenus (`destroySubMenus()`, which `destroy()` shares). `test/playwright/unit/menu/List.spec.mjs` replays your case: Alpha's Move to offers Images and Archive, Beta's then offers Documents and Archive, and Beta's Archive handler moves Beta only. On the unfixed engine it fails (`alphaSubmenu.isDestroyed` is `undefined`).

**A second defect on the same path, outside this RA:** in a browser, opening Move to for one file and then right-clicking another renders the root menu's new items twice, two `li` per item with one id. It happens on 402f75bf08 too, before this repair, and never when no submenu was opened first. It is captured as a defect-note with the three mechanisms I tested and falsified (two store loads, a refill while mounted, the parent's `aria-expanded` update in flight). That is why the regression above is a unit spec: the e2e of your sequence fails on the doubling, and it is saved for that repair. My read is that it does not block this card: the actions act on the right file again, and the doubling needs a submenu left open while another file is right-clicked. I will file it under #21367 and repair it before the lock if the budget holds.

All Required Actions are discharged against B at this head. CI is pending at b4860ca006; the re-request goes out at green.
